text: The rabbit hole went straight on like a tunnel. <break time="0.8s" /> For some way. <break time="0.8s" /> Then it dipped suddenly. <break time="0.8s" /> And Alice found herself. <break time="0.8s" /> Falling down a very deep well. <break time="0.8s" /> Either the well was very deep. <break time="0.8s" /> Or she fell very slowly. <break time="0.8s" /> She had plenty of time. <break time="0.8s" /> To look around. <break time="0.8s" /> And to wonder. <break time="0.8s" /> What would happen next. <break time="0.8s" /> The sides of the well. <break time="0.8s" /> Were filled with cupboards and bookshelves. <break time="0.8s" /> As she passed. <break time="0.8s" /> She took down a jar. <break time="0.8s" /> From one of the shelves. <break time="0.8s" /> It had a label. <break time="0.8s" /> That said ORANGE MARMALADE. <break time="0.8s" /> But it was empty. <break time="0.8s" /> She did not want to drop it. <break time="0.8s" /> Because it might hit. <break time="0.8s" /> Someone below. <break time="0.8s" /> So she put it. <break time="0.8s" /> Into a cupboard. <break time="0.8s" /> As she fell past it. <break time="0.8s" /> After a fall like this. <break time="0.8s" /> Falling downstairs will be nothing. <break time="0.8s" /> Thought Alice. <break time="0.8s" /> She wondered. <break time="0.8s" /> If she was getting near the center of the earth. <break time="0.8s" /> She also said grand words. <break time="0.8s" /> Like Latitude and Longitude. <break time="0.8s" /> Which she did not understand at all.
